title: Fix KV cache capacity, decode reservations, and waiting-request reclamation
body:
## Summary

Fix three KV-cache resource-accounting failures:

- Choose the minimum profiled block capacity across ranks before even-count alignment.
- Admit decode requests using their actual missing-block count, including in-flight and draft reservations; allocate the entire deficit and retain surplus trimming.
- Release cache/state references when terminated waiting requests are removed, and clear released state handles.

The scheduler keeps its existing allocation lock, reservation formula, and preemption ordering.

## Regression coverage

Add core CUDA/Ascend-selected CPU scheduler and worker regressions for capacity imbalance, full-cache decode, speculative reservations, multiple missing blocks and victims, pinned references, repeated partial-prefill cancellation, forks, and recompute cleanup.

Run the checked-in suite against a built extension:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/worker/test_cache_capacity.py \
  tests/engine/test_scheduler_decode_blocks.py \
  tests/engine/test_scheduler_reclamation.py -q
```

## Validation performed

- Actual-header C++ decode harness: baseline **28 failures / 8 passes**, fixed **36 passes**. Uses real Scheduler, Sequence, and BlockManager with CPU PyTorch. The recorded macOS run used temporary utility-header portability adaptations; the full reproduction and exact adaptations are attached to issue #3 below.
- Cache-capacity tests: **7 passed**, exercising the real WorkerBase method with mocked memory observations and collective results. Local import bootstrap replaces accelerator-only dependencies.
- Extracted C++ reclamation/control-path harness: **392 passed** on the combined branch.
- Ruff, Python compilation, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Combined integration check with #34 and #36: merged without conflicts in an isolated worktree; **36 native scheduler cases, 2 native cancellation/output cases, and 12 sampling-parameter tests passed**.
- Independent review of the combined production changes, ownership paths, native bindings, and tests completed with no actionable findings. Its CI-selection and test-comment findings were corrected.

Upstream issues are disabled; tracking and reproduction evidence:

Closes https://github.com/morluto/DeepInfer/issues/1
Closes https://github.com/morluto/DeepInfer/issues/3
Closes https://github.com/morluto/DeepInfer/issues/4
